name: opencode-cloud
description: Experiment running the OpenCode web UI inside Cloudflare Sandbox

scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:web && WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:web && wrangler dev --var PERSISTENCE_LOCAL_BUCKET:true
scripts.start: pnpm run build:web && wrangler dev --var PERSISTENCE_LOCAL_BUCKET:true
scripts.typecheck: WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false wrangler types --strict-vars=false && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p web
